title: Palindrome After Cleanup
prompt:
Given a string `s`, decide whether it reads the same forwards and backwards after you ignore every character that is not an ASCII letter or digit and treat uppercase and lowercase letters as equal. A string with no letters or digits counts as a palindrome.

Signature: `fn is_clean_palindrome(s: &str) -> bool`

Try to solve it with two pointers and O(1) extra space (no new String).

Example:
  is_clean_palindrome("Was it a car, or a cat I saw?") -> true
  is_clean_palindrome("race a car") -> false
